checkpoints.description: [1/4] UI readability pass 3: add a four-glyph board symbol key to the field guide, with a before/after help pair at 1440 and 390 and a browser overflow check

impact_assessment.why: The field guide names emitters, mirrors, dye cells and receivers in prose but never shows the glyphs the player sees on the board. The README table explains them; the in-game guide does not, so a first-time player has to infer four symbols from the board.
impact_assessment.benefits: The guide maps circle-arrow, slanted line, ringed circle and double ring to their names and rules in one glance, using the same beam tokens as the board; no runtime or save change.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: PLAYABLE.md static assets only; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: help copy only.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Use CSS-only swatches with existing beam tokens, add failing-first tests for four labeled symbol rows, check both 1440 and 390 widths for horizontal overflow, and keep the guide opening at its heading.

checkpoints.description: Task 'iris-cycle-08' completed successfully.
[1/4] Input feel pass 2: make Reset undoable so an accidental restart can be recovered, proven by a same-state reset screenshot pair and a rotate-reset-undo played run

impact_assessment.why: Reset calls openLevel, which clears the undo stack and the move count. A player who misclicks Reset loses the whole route with no way back, even though Undo sits next to Reset and normally restores every other move.
impact_assessment.benefits: Reset becomes another reversible action: the pre-reset board and move count go on the undo stack, Undo is enabled after a reset, and the existing 80-step bound and hint cleanup still apply.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: no save or level change; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: undo stack growth, preview mode must stay preview, hints and timers must clear.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Keep reset on the current level object, push the previous game before recreating it, clear the hint timer, cap the stack at 80, and verify preview reset plus rotate-reset-undo in the browser dogfood.

checkpoints.description: [2/4]-[3/4] Made reset push the pre-reset board, recreated the level in place, cleared hints and preserved preview, with a failing-first reset/undo browser run and same-scroll before/after pairs

checkpoints.description: Task 'iris-cycle-09' completed successfully.
[1/4] Audio pass 2: make the sound toggle stop already-scheduled voices immediately, proven by a mute-during-cue unit test and a browser stop-log run

impact_assessment.why: setMuted(true) only blocks future play() calls. A cue that is already scheduled keeps sounding, so toggling sound off during the win arpeggio or a hint ping does not silence it.
impact_assessment.benefits: The Sound on/off control takes effect immediately: every active oscillator is stopped and disconnected when muting, while unmuting leaves future cues untouched. No audio file or network change.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: generated audio only; dependency: none; concurrency: one Set of active voices per audio instance; state: no save change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Track each oscillator/amplifier pair, remove it on ended, stop and disconnect all voices on mute, guard against double-stop, and test with the fake AudioContext plus a browser stop log.

checkpoints.description: Task 'iris-cycle-10' completed successfully.
[1/4] UI readability pass 4: explain the receiver ring and dot in the symbol key and make the emitter swatch arrow legible, with 1440/390 help pairs

impact_assessment.why: The symbol key says only that a receiver wants one exact hue. The board actually draws the target as the ring and the incoming color as the center dot, which is the one convention the key does not explain. The emitter swatch arrow is also hard to see at normal size.
impact_assessment.benefits: A first-time player can read the receiver state from the glyph after one look, and the emitter direction is visible in the key without zooming; no runtime or save change.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: static help copy and CSS only; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Keep the explanation in the receiver label, enlarge the swatch arrow without changing the board glyphs, add a failing-first copy test, and re-check 1440/390 overflow.
